notes:
## 0.2.214

owes: none — the distribution now carries LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES at its root (SPEC-135)
owes: none — the image now carries /app/LICENSE and /app/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES (SPEC-135)
owes: none — `com.mambocoding.sync` re-pinned 0.10.1 → 0.10.3 and DataCore's `feed`/`weather`/`stocks` to 0.5.28 (feed and weather from 0.5.19, stocks from 0.5.26). SyncCore's interval: 0.10.2 asks every `SyncStore` to leave server-owned rows out of `markAllPending` (the desktop replica does, SPEC-047); 0.10.3 is tooling only. DataCore's intervals: a JSON Feed item whose `id` was a JSON `null` (`<source>::null`) and an item whose title or description holds a bare `&` move once to a new id; the weather extractor reads day and list pages differently (hours, joined grids, sub-zero signs), so an existing page city's forecast may change values and a place key for an address `java.net.URI` cannot read a host from moves once; stored selectors and the wire are unchanged. No migration, key or default changes.
owes: none — the desktop replica's `markAllPending` no longer marks server-owned (`<app>.shared_*`) or hub-local (`<app>.local_*`) rows pending, so after a hub restore it stops pushing the shared tier (which the hub refuses whole, 403 `server_owned_collection`) and `feed.shared_articles` keeps pulling; nothing to migrate and neither module is in the image (SPEC-047).
owes: none — build only: the image's builder stage is back on `eclipse-temurin:17-jdk` (Dependabot's `ac3c9c1` had moved it to 24, where Gradle finds no JDK 17 toolchain and downloads one during every image build), and Dependabot no longer proposes a major `eclipse-temurin` bump for it (AUD-SH-602). The runtime stage stays `eclipse-temurin:25-jre`; the running hub's contents, keys and defaults are unchanged.
owes: none — comments only (AUD-SH-604, AUD-SH-06, AUD-SH-09): citations of the deleted decision and review files now name the specs that carry them or are dropped, and the catalog and `gradle.properties` comments name Gradle 9.8.0 and `:replica`'s `api` dependency on sync-core. No code, configuration, wire or data change.
owes: new route `POST /settings/backup/upload` and an *Upload a snapshot* form on Settings → Backup and on a fresh hub's first setup step (no migration, no configuration key). It takes a snapshot of up to 16 GiB, so a reverse proxy in front of the hub must allow a request body that large on that path (nginx `client_max_body_size`); the hub itself needs room for the file in `SYNCHUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR`. A restore stays a separate step.
owes: none — CI only: `gradle/actions/dependency-submission` 6.3.0 → 6.4.0 in `release.yml` (Dependabot `8b671b6`); no image content, key, default or URL changes.
owes: paired phones re-send everything once after a hub restore — `/sync/pull` and `/sync/push` now answer the hub's `generation` (32 lowercase hex, minted once and forgotten by a snapshot restore), and a device on SyncCore 0.10.0 or later that sees it change marks all its records pending, resets its cursors and syncs again. Devices on an older SyncCore ignore the field and behave as before.
owes: none — `com.mambocoding.sync:protocol` and `:core` re-pinned 0.9.20 → 0.10.1 (SPEC-047). The hub image takes the additive DTO fields and the backup-catalogue shapes (unused until `/backups/{app}` lands); the desktop reader's replica gains migration `V002__hub_generation.sql` (forward-only: a replica opened by this build cannot be opened by an older one). SyncCore 0.9.21 refuses a stored `http://` hub address at the transport, so a desktop reader paired over plain HTTP must re-pair on `https://`. 0.10.1: `ReplicaSyncStore.resetCursors` clears cursors only (checked), so held tombstones survive a restore. `com.mambocoding.feed:core` and `weather:core` stay on 0.5.19; their intervals owe "re-pin together" lines (ids move once, extraction changes) and are a separate re-pin.
owes: none — SPEC-134: `:client`'s UI-free packages (`config`, `media`, `pairing`, `repo`, `store`, `sync`, `ui/HtmlFragment.kt`) and the replica's migrations moved into the new `:replica` module, package names kept; `:client`'s behaviour, the replica schema and the wire are unchanged, and neither module is in the image.
owes: none — SPEC-134: the `:engine` module (contract `engine/1`, an AF_UNIX socket and no TCP listener) and `:engine:appImage`; the hub's routes, keys, defaults and the image are unchanged, and `:server`'s `checkImageIsolation` fails the build if either new module reaches the image's classpath.
owes: SyncDesk — every Release cut from here carries `synchub-engine-<version>-windows-x64.zip` (an unsigned jpackage app-image, launcher `synchub-engine`, built on `windows-latest` by the `engine-windows` job after the Release exists); pin a SyncHub tag and bundle it. The contract is `engine/1` (SPEC-134). A bare `pair{url, code}` for a self-signed hub answers error `-32005` with the fingerprint to confirm and sends nothing; call `pair` again with `fingerprint`.
owes: schema migration V031 (`backup_entries`) — forward-only; a database that has run it is refused by an older image, so a rollback after the first start needs a backup taken before it (SPEC-017).
owes: new device routes `GET` and `POST /backups/{app}` and `DELETE /backups/{app}/{id}` on the device token: an app on SyncCore 0.10 or later can keep its daily, monthly and manual backups on the hub, three daily and two monthly per app kept, manual ones never pruned. The file itself is a blob, so it counts against the owner's blob claims and `SYNCHUB_BLOB_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES`; the catalogue bodies stay within 1 MiB, so a reverse proxy needs no new rule (SPEC-017).
owes: new signed-in page `/backups`, offered on Settings for every account, listing a user's own app backups with *Download* and *Delete*; a hub restore leaves the catalogue and its files alone, and a snapshot never carries them (SPEC-017).
owes: none — `com.mambocoding.stocks:core` re-pinned 0.5.23 → 0.5.26; DataCore's notes for that interval all read `none` for the `core`, `weather` and `stocks` consumers (the new storage connectors are other artifacts, not pulled here).
owes: none — build and agent tooling only: `tooling/` re-pinned v0.1.1 → v0.1.12, the `preflight@` ref and the `actions/checkout` pin comment in `release.yml` and `desktop-installers.yml` follow, `.claude/settings.json`'s hook block is the template's, and `CLAUDE.md` moves to the master form; no image content, key, default or URL changes.
owes: the broker connection now uses SyncHub's own MQTT 3.1.1 client on io.netty:netty-codec-mqtt 4.2.17.Final in place of Paho mqttv3 1.2.5; no setting, hub_state key or state token changes, a confirmed fingerprint and the sealed password stay valid; re-run Settings → Sensor broker → Test connection once after the update (SPEC-120)
